h_frozen: Pressure below which no more water will freeze.
ice_dt: Timestep to use when ice is enabled. This applies when there are subzero temperatures in the profile.

X_ice_buffer: Ice volume that didn’t fit the soil durin freezing.
Theta_primary: Water content in primary matrix system. Conventionally, this is the intra- aggregate pores.
Theta_secondary: Water content in secondary matrix system. Conventionally, this is the inter- aggregate pores.
S_sum: Total water sink (due to root uptake and macropores).
S_incorp: Incorporated water sink, typically from subsoil irrigation.
S_ice: Ice sink due to thawing or freezing.
S_ice_water: Water sink due to thawing or freezing.
S_forward_total: Sink (including source terms) at beginning of timestep. Used for limiting size of timestep. Currently this includes drain and tertiary domain (biopores).
S_forward_sink: Sink (excluding source terms) at beginning of timestep. Used for limiting size of timestep. Currently this includes drain and tertiary domain (biopores).
q_primary: Primary domain water flux (positive numbers mean upward).
q_secondary: Secondary domain water flux (positive numbers mean upward).
q_p: Water flux in macro pores (positive numbers mean upward).
table_low: Groundwater table estimated by presure in lowest unsaturated cell. If there are multiple unsaturated cells in the same depth, the one with the lowest pressure will be used.
table_high: Groundwater table estimated by presure in highest saturated cell. If there are multiple saturated cells in the same depth, the one with the highest pressure will be used.
Psa: Amount of snow in a day required for snow to become new.
fsa: Fraction of snow in precipitation required for snow to become new.
K_snow_factor: Factor related to thermal conductivity for snow water mix.
partial_snow: Amount of snow received this day so far. Snow age is reset when at least ’Psa’ is receieved within a day.
partial_precipitation: Amount of precipitation received this day so far. At least ’fsa’ of this must be snow for snow age to be reset.
wday: Current weekday. Monday is 1, Sunday is 7.
allow_old_units: OBSOLETE: Set this to true to enable the old system of build-in unit con- versation.
